judge.rationale: The candidate implementation is clearly unfinished and leaves its own `.lore/dod.md` tracking file in the repository with unchecked tasks. In `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts`, it calls `this.resolveDefinition(tool.definitionSource)` unconditionally inside `execute` even for static tools, and uses a default `import Ajv from 'ajv'` which causes ESM/TypeScript interoperability issues under NodeNext compared to the reference's named `{Ajv}` import. Furthermore, it omits almost all required unit tests in `registry.test.ts` (extra property pass-through, dynamic schema updates, unknown tool throw, etc.), the test in `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, the required one-line JSDoc comment on `execute`, and the validation failure warning log. Finally, none of the required documentation updates to `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, or `example/weather-tool.ts` were performed, and the `CHANGELOG.md` entry is incomplete.
